model_note: Intended bands for the fictional packets. A = invite to interview (pass), B = committee should look (review), C = do not advance (fail).

01_avery_chen.name: Avery Chen
01_avery_chen.note: Two years of research, a first-author workshop paper, a specific MSAI plan, and two detailed letters.

02_priya_shah.name: Priya Shah
02_priya_shah.note: Shipped a production ranker, a quantitative degree, a specific evaluation question, and strong letters.

03_marcus_hale.name: Marcus Hale
03_marcus_hale.note: Open-source solvers with outside contributors, a heavy mathematics record, and a specific MSAI plan.

04_elena_vasquez.name: Elena Vasquez
04_elena_vasquez.note: Second-author robotics paper with a clearly owned part, teaching, and a specific perception project.

05_jordan_hale.name: Jordan Hale
05_jordan_hale.note: Strong retrieval demo and letters, but the statement of purpose is generic. Technical and fit readers should disagree.

06_sam_okonkwo.name: Sam Okonkwo
06_sam_okonkwo.note: Specific public-data statement and night-school mathematics, with little technical depth. Fit and technical readers should disagree.

07_riley_nguyen.name: Riley Nguyen
07_riley_nguyen.note: Honest capstone, foundational courses, no paper or internship model. A committee look, not an automatic invite.

08_taylor_brooks.name: Taylor Brooks
08_taylor_brooks.note: One careful internship notebook, B-level theory grades, and a second letter that is only collegial.

09_casey_morgan.name: Casey Morgan
09_casey_morgan.note: Tutorial class projects, a vague statement, and letters that say only that the applicant works hard.

10_drew_patel.name: Drew Patel
10_drew_patel.note: High biology grades and almost no computing. The statement names medicine and AI without a technical plan.

11_quinn_alvarez.name: Quinn Alvarez
11_quinn_alvarez.note: A four-week lab visit, course minimums, a 2.95 GPA, and letters that mention missed deadlines.

12_harper_singh.name: Harper Singh
12_harper_singh.note: A communications degree, an online quiz certificate, and letters about writing rather than quantitative work.
